dialogues.speaker: Oda Tarou
dialogues.text: Hello, are you an outlander traveling in Inazuma?

dialogues.speaker: Oda Tarou
dialogues.text: Although being on a journey is fun, don't forget to go home sometimes.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About your homeland...

dialogues.speaker: Oda Tarou
dialogues.text: My homeland is Seirai Island. Every generation of my family has resided there. Later on, we were relocated by the Shogunate alongside the other residents on the island to the Narukami Island.

dialogues.speaker: Oda Tarou
dialogues.text: There are many descendants of the Seirai Island locals in Inazuma now. I remember, for instance, that Miss Fujiwara's ancestors were from Seirai as well.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Oda Tarou
dialogues.text: Farewell! I wish you good fortune in the long journey ahead.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why did the Shogunate tell you to move?

dialogues.speaker: Oda Tarou
dialogues.text: The reason... Well, I can't remember. It's been many generations after all.

dialogues.speaker: Oda Tarou
dialogues.text: Some people said it was because of the rampant lightning storms on Seirai Island. Some said it was to prevent smuggling and stowaways... Anyway, there are many theories, and they all sound pretty plausible.

dialogues.speaker: Oda Tarou
dialogues.text: As the children of the Electro Archon, we listened to the Shogunate's order, of course. After relocating to Narukami Island, my family started doing business in the city, and we eventually became affluent. Turns out it's actually better than staying on a lonely island.

dialogues.speaker: Oda Tarou
dialogues.text: Still, Seirai Island is my hometown. To think that we have no idea what's going on there anymore...

dialogues.speaker: Oda Tarou
dialogues.text: Hello there! Thanks for your help previously.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why did the Shogunate tell you to move?

dialogues.speaker: Oda Tarou
dialogues.text: The reason... Well, I can't remember. It's been many generations after all.

dialogues.speaker: Oda Tarou
dialogues.text: Some people said it was because of the rampant lightning storms on Seirai Island. Some said it was to prevent smuggling and stowaways... Anyway, there are many theories, and they all sound pretty plausible.

dialogues.speaker: Oda Tarou
dialogues.text: As the children of Electro Archon, we listened to the Shogunate's order, of course. After relocating to Narukami Island, my family started doing business in the city, and we eventually became affluent. Turns out it's actually better than staying on a lonely island.

dialogues.speaker: Oda Tarou
dialogues.text: Right, I should also thank you again for taking those photos for me on Seirai Island.

dialogues.speaker: Oda Tarou
dialogues.text: Thanks to you, I finally know what my homeland of old looks like today.

dialogues.speaker: Oda Tarou
dialogues.text: *sigh* I'd love to go there in person should the opportunity arise...
